title: Zesty Lacquered French Rainbow Trout Mille Feuille
description: A low-carb, bitter, and pillowy French dish from Lyon, featuring rainbow trout and a lacquer glaze, served in a kadhai, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together almond flour, granulated sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Place a kadhai over medium heat and add olive oil.
Add the rainbow trout fillets to the kadhai, skin side up, and sear for 2 minutes.
Flip the trout fillets and sear for another 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard and lemon juice.
Brush the mustard mixture evenly over the trout fillets.
Place the kadhai in the oven and bake for 8 minutes.
While the trout is baking, mix together unsalted butter and egg in a small bowl.
Remove the kadhai from the oven and brush the butter mixture evenly over the trout fillets.
Return the kadhai to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes.
